name: record-video
title_zh: 把浏览器操作录成可回放的上传视频
tagline_zh: 演示 bug、走查流程、留交接证据时，别再开录屏软件。它把一次浏览器交互变成一段短视频，直接产出可上传的 arti。
tagline_en: Stop opening a screen recorder to show a bug or walk through a flow. This turns any browser interaction into a.
desc_en: Record and upload a short browser interaction video artifact
why_zh: 不是录整个屏幕，而是按 DOM 事件重放，画质清晰、体积小，且天然只含操作区域，隐私噪音少。
why_en: It replays DOM events rather than capturing the whole screen—crisper, smaller, and free of unrelated desktop clutter.
limit_zh: 只支持 Chromium 系浏览器，且需本机装有 ffmpeg；产物是 WebM 格式，不含系统音频，仅录页面内操作。
limit_en: Chromium-only; requires local ffmpeg. Output is WebM with no system audio—just in-page interactions.
